# apple_subscription_offer_codes (Data Source)

Lists the offer codes of an auto-renewable subscription, including deactivated ones — Apple keeps every offer forever.

It exists for the offers made by hand in App Store Connect: their IDs appear nowhere in the UI, and the ID is what `terraform import apple_subscription_offer_code` takes. `subscription_id` is required because Apple publishes no top-level offer code collection. Prices are not listed — reading them is one request per offer; the resource reads them on import.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every offer of a subscription, including deactivated ones -- Apple keeps them
# all. The IDs are what terraform import takes for an offer made by hand.
data "apple_subscription_offer_codes" "all" {
  subscription_id = "6740021496"
}

# name_pattern is a regular expression matched as a substring.
data "apple_subscription_offer_codes" "live_school_offers" {
  subscription_id = "6740021496"
  name_pattern    = "(?i)school"
  active          = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `subscription_id` (String) The ID of the subscription whose offer codes to list.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Return only active offers (`true`) or only deactivated ones (`false`). Unset returns both.
- `name_pattern` (String) Regular expression matched against each offer's reference name. Matches as a substring unless anchored with `^` and `$`.

### Read-Only

- `filtered_count` (Number) Number of offer codes remaining after filtering.
- `offer_codes` (Attributes List) The offer codes matching the filters, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--offer_codes))
- `total_count` (Number) Total number of offer codes on the subscription before filtering.

<a id="nestedatt--offer_codes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `offer_codes`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the offer can still be redeemed.
- `auto_renew_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the subscription renews once the offer ends.
- `customer_eligibilities` (List of String) Who may redeem it: `NEW`, `EXISTING` and/or `EXPIRED`.
- `duration` (String) The length of one offer period.
- `id` (String) The unique Apple-generated identifier for the offer code.
- `name` (String) The offer's reference name.
- `number_of_periods` (Number) How many periods the offer lasts.
- `offer_eligibility` (String) `STACK_WITH_INTRO_OFFERS` or `REPLACE_INTRO_OFFERS`.
- `offer_mode` (String) `PAY_AS_YOU_GO`, `PAY_UP_FRONT` or `FREE_TRIAL`.
- `production_code_count` (Number) How many of them redeem in production.
- `sandbox_code_count` (Number) How many of them redeem in the sandbox.
- `target_subscription_plan_type` (String) `MONTHLY` or `UPFRONT`, when Apple reports one.
- `total_number_of_codes` (Number) How many codes Apple reports for the offer.
